dialogue.text: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了我們自然世界中變化的模式，包括氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化するパターン、気候、季節の移り変わり、天文学を観察しました。
dialogue.local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

dialogue.text: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運行劃分為24條路徑，創造了24節氣，這些節氣用來管理古代中國的農業。
dialogue.ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを測定し、24の区分に分けて24節気を作り出し、古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
dialogue.local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

dialogue.text: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍然指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
dialogue.ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は数億人の中国人の生活や伝統を導いています。
dialogue.local: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.en: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

dialogue.text: Around the 8th of October, 17th solar term, the cold Dew arrives.
dialogue.zh: 大約在10月8日，17節氣，寒露來臨。
dialogue.ja: 10月8日頃、17番目の節気である寒露が訪れます。
dialogue.local: Around the 8th of October, 17th solar term, the cold Dew arrives.
dialogue.en: Around the 8th of October, 17th solar term, the cold Dew arrives.

dialogue.text: The temperature has now cooled down noticeably and the weather is unpredictable.
dialogue.zh: 氣溫明顯下降，天氣變得難以預測。
dialogue.ja: 気温は明らかに下がり、天気は予測が難しくなっています。
dialogue.local: The temperature has now cooled down noticeably and the weather is unpredictable.
dialogue.en: The temperature has now cooled down noticeably and the weather is unpredictable.

dialogue.text: The Chongyang festival is one of the traditional festivals for Chinese people to respect the old.
dialogue.zh: 重陽節是中國人尊敬長輩的傳統節日之一。
dialogue.ja: 重陽節は中国人が年長者を敬う伝統的な祭りの一つです。
dialogue.local: The Chongyang festival is one of the traditional festivals for Chinese people to respect the old.
dialogue.en: The Chongyang festival is one of the traditional festivals for Chinese people to respect the old.

dialogue.text: People climb the hills and the mountains and pray for continued blessings.
dialogue.zh: 人們登山攀丘，祈求持續的祝福。
dialogue.ja: 人々は丘や山に登り、継続的な幸運を祈ります。
dialogue.local: People climb the hills and the mountains and pray for continued blessings.
dialogue.en: People climb the hills and the mountains and pray for continued blessings.

dialogue.text: The lotuses of the summer have all withered 15 days after the last solar term, the calendar has moved on to the 17th solar term, named Han Lu.
dialogue.zh: 夏天的蓮花已經凋謝，距離上一個節氣15天後，日曆進入第17節氣，稱為寒露。
dialogue.ja: 夏の蓮はすべて枯れ、前の節気から15日後にカレンダーは17番目の節気、寒露に移ります。
dialogue.local: The lotuses of the summer have all withered 15 days after the last solar term, the calendar has moved on to the 17th solar term, named Han Lu.
dialogue.en: The lotuses of the summer have all withered 15 days after the last solar term, the calendar has moved on to the 17th solar term, named Han Lu.

dialogue.text: It refers to the cold Dew as it condenses and almost becomes frost.
dialogue.zh: 寒露指的是冷露凝結，幾乎成霜。
dialogue.ja: 寒露は冷たい露が凝縮してほとんど霜になることを指します。
dialogue.local: It refers to the cold Dew as it condenses and almost becomes frost.
dialogue.en: It refers to the cold Dew as it condenses and almost becomes frost.

dialogue.text: However, the colder the weather, the easier it is to build up an appetite and in this autumn weather as it starts to cool down, the Chinese have a solution, seeking out a special kind of delicious food.
dialogue.zh: 然而，天氣越冷，胃口越好，在這漸涼的秋天，中國人有一個解決方法，就是尋找一種特別美味的食物。
dialogue.ja: しかし、寒くなるほど食欲が増し、この秋の涼しい天気の中で、中国人は特別なおいしい食べ物を求める方法を持っています。
dialogue.local: However, the colder the weather, the easier it is to build up an appetite and in this autumn weather as it starts to cool down, the Chinese have a solution, seeking out a special kind of delicious food.
dialogue.en: However, the colder the weather, the easier it is to build up an appetite and in this autumn weather as it starts to cool down, the Chinese have a solution, seeking out a special kind of delicious food.

dialogue.text: Shanghai's Chongvan temple is packed with people.
dialogue.zh: 上海的崇安寺擠滿了人。
dialogue.ja: 上海の崇安寺は人でいっぱいです。
dialogue.local: Shanghai's Chongvan temple is packed with people.
dialogue.en: Shanghai's Chongvan temple is packed with people.

dialogue.text: People come from all over, drawn to Shanghai's local delicacies.
dialogue.zh: 人們從各地而來，被上海的地方美食吸引。
dialogue.ja: 人々は上海の地元の美味しい料理に惹かれて全国から集まります。
dialogue.local: People come from all over, drawn to Shanghai's local delicacies.
dialogue.en: People come from all over, drawn to Shanghai's local delicacies.

dialogue.text: These snacks are world famous.
dialogue.zh: 這些小吃享譽世界。
dialogue.ja: これらのスナックは世界的に有名です。
dialogue.local: These snacks are world famous.
dialogue.en: These snacks are world famous.

dialogue.text: The Han Lu solar term is all about unmissable flavours.
dialogue.zh: 寒露節氣充滿了不可錯過的美味。
dialogue.ja: 寒露の節気は見逃せない味わいでいっぱいです。
dialogue.local: The Han Lu solar term is all about unmissable flavours.
dialogue.en: The Han Lu solar term is all about unmissable flavours.

dialogue.text: But, if you're not around for these few days of feasting, we'll have to wait an entire year to get the chance.
dialogue.zh: 但是，如果你錯過了這幾天的盛宴，就得等上一整年才能有機會品嚐。
dialogue.ja: しかし、この数日の宴に参加できなければ、チャンスを得るために1年待たなければなりません。
dialogue.local: But, if you're not around for these few days of feasting, we'll have to wait an entire year to get the chance.
dialogue.en: But, if you're not around for these few days of feasting, we'll have to wait an entire year to get the chance.

dialogue.text: There are simply too many people.
dialogue.zh: 人實在太多了。
dialogue.ja: 単に人が多すぎます。
dialogue.local: There are simply too many people.
dialogue.en: There are simply too many people.

dialogue.text: The store was full a long time ago.
dialogue.zh: 店裡早就滿了。
dialogue.ja: 店はずっと前から満員でした。
dialogue.local: The store was full a long time ago.
dialogue.en: The store was full a long time ago.

dialogue.text: Like everyone else who got out of bed at a more reasonable hour, I can only stand outside to taste this legendary dumpling.
dialogue.zh: 像其他較早起床的人一樣，我只能站在外面品嚐這傳奇的餃子。
dialogue.ja: もっと早く起きた他の人たちと同じように、私は外でこの伝説の餃子を味わうしかありません。
dialogue.local: Like everyone else who got out of bed at a more reasonable hour, I can only stand outside to taste this legendary dumpling.
dialogue.en: Like everyone else who got out of bed at a more reasonable hour, I can only stand outside to taste this legendary dumpling.

dialogue.text: Soup filled finely wrapped dumplings have a long history in China.
dialogue.zh: 湯包在中國有著悠久的歷史。
dialogue.ja: スープ入りの繊細に包まれた餃子は中国で長い歴史があります。
dialogue.local: Soup filled finely wrapped dumplings have a long history in China.
dialogue.en: Soup filled finely wrapped dumplings have a long history in China.

dialogue.text: The dough wrappings are first lightly fermented and then wrapped with the fillings.
dialogue.zh: 麵皮先輕微發酵，然後包裹餡料。
dialogue.ja: 生地はまず軽く発酵され、その後具材で包まれます。
dialogue.local: The dough wrappings are first lightly fermented and then wrapped with the fillings.
dialogue.en: The dough wrappings are first lightly fermented and then wrapped with the fillings.

dialogue.text: In these steamed soup dumplings, flour, meat and soup become one, satisfying the belly and tickling the senses.
dialogue.zh: 在這些蒸湯包中，麵粉、肉和湯融為一體，滿足味蕾和胃口。
dialogue.ja: これらの蒸しスープ餃子では、小麦粉、肉、スープが一体となり、満腹感と感覚を刺激します。
dialogue.local: In these steamed soup dumplings, flour, meat and soup become one, satisfying the belly and tickling the senses.
dialogue.en: In these steamed soup dumplings, flour, meat and soup become one, satisfying the belly and tickling the senses.

dialogue.text: Crab soup dumplings are the highest form of the art.
dialogue.zh: 蟹肉湯包是這門藝術的最高形式。
dialogue.ja: 蟹のスープ餃子はこの芸術の最高形態です。
dialogue.local: Crab soup dumplings are the highest form of the art.
dialogue.en: Crab soup dumplings are the highest form of the art.

dialogue.text: The crab roe and meat are selected from the most expensive crabs in the market.
dialogue.zh: 蟹黃和蟹肉選自市場上最昂貴的螃蟹。
dialogue.ja: 蟹の卵と肉は市場で最も高価な蟹から選ばれます。
dialogue.local: The crab roe and meat are selected from the most expensive crabs in the market.
dialogue.en: The crab roe and meat are selected from the most expensive crabs in the market.

dialogue.text: Mixed with pork, fish and shrimp, and wrapped in a thin and strong flour wrapping.
dialogue.zh: 與豬肉、魚和蝦混合，包裹在薄而結實的麵皮中。
dialogue.ja: 豚肉、魚、エビと混ぜられ、薄くて丈夫な生地で包まれます。
dialogue.local: Mixed with pork, fish and shrimp, and wrapped in a thin and strong flour wrapping.
dialogue.en: Mixed with pork, fish and shrimp, and wrapped in a thin and strong flour wrapping.

dialogue.text: In steamed, they become crab soup dumplings with a rich soup and a delicate yet complex flavour of crab meat.
dialogue.zh: 蒸熟後，它們成為蟹肉湯包，湯汁濃郁，蟹肉味道細膩而複雜。
dialogue.ja: 蒸すと、濃厚なスープと繊細で複雑な蟹肉の味わいの蟹スープ餃子になります。
dialogue.local: In steamed, they become crab soup dumplings with a rich soup and a delicate yet complex flavour of crab meat.
dialogue.en: In steamed, they become crab soup dumplings with a rich soup and a delicate yet complex flavour of crab meat.

dialogue.text: The reason why crab soup dumplings are unique to this solar term is because their most important ingredient crabs are at their plumpest and most succulent when the dew turns cold.
dialogue.zh: 蟹肉湯包之所以獨特，是因為當露水變冷時，螃蟹最肥美多汁，是最重要的食材。
dialogue.ja: 蟹スープ餃子がこの節気に特有なのは、露が冷たくなるときに蟹が最もふっくらとしてジューシーになるからです。
dialogue.local: The reason why crab soup dumplings are unique to this solar term is because their most important ingredient crabs are at their plumpest and most succulent when the dew turns cold.
dialogue.en: The reason why crab soup dumplings are unique to this solar term is because their most important ingredient crabs are at their plumpest and most succulent when the dew turns cold.

dialogue.text: Less than an hour's drive from Shanghai is the renowned fresh water Yangcheng lake; for Chinese food lovers this place is holy.
dialogue.zh: 距離上海不到一小時車程的是著名的淡水陽澄湖，對中國美食愛好者來說，這裡是聖地。
dialogue.ja: 上海から車で1時間以内の有名な淡水の陽澄湖は、中国の食通にとって聖地です。
dialogue.local: Less than an hour's drive from Shanghai is the renowned fresh water Yangcheng lake; for Chinese food lovers this place is holy.
dialogue.en: Less than an hour's drive from Shanghai is the renowned fresh water Yangcheng lake; for Chinese food lovers this place is holy.

dialogue.text: The creatures that live in here are a cut above those found in any other lake.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的生物比其他任何湖泊的都要優秀。
dialogue.ja: ここに生息する生き物は他のどの湖よりも優れています。
dialogue.local: The creatures that live in here are a cut above those found in any other lake.
dialogue.en: The creatures that live in here are a cut above those found in any other lake.

dialogue.text: Hairy crabs are caught once a year during the cold dew solar term; it is a hugely famous annual event.
dialogue.zh: 毛蟹每年只在寒露節氣捕撈一次，這是一個非常著名的年度盛事。
dialogue.ja: 毛蟹は寒露の節気に年に一度だけ捕獲される、とても有名な年中行事です。
dialogue.local: Hairy crabs are caught once a year during the cold dew solar term; it is a hugely famous annual event.
dialogue.en: Hairy crabs are caught once a year during the cold dew solar term; it is a hugely famous annual event.

dialogue.text: Crab tasting is such a seasonal pastime that every year when the cold dew solar term comes around masses of people show up at the Bachang town on the shores of the Yangcheng lake to taste the great first catch of the year.
dialogue.zh: 品蟹是如此季節性的娛樂，每年寒露節氣來臨時，大批人群會聚集在陽澄湖岸邊的巴城鎮，品嚐當年的第一批豐收。
dialogue.ja: 蟹の味見は季節限定の娯楽で、毎年寒露の節気になると多くの人が陽澄湖の岸辺にある巴城町に集まり、その年の最初の大漁を味わいます。
dialogue.local: Crab tasting is such a seasonal pastime that every year when the cold dew solar term comes around masses of people show up at the Bachang town on the shores of the Yangcheng lake to taste the great first catch of the year.
dialogue.en: Crab tasting is such a seasonal pastime that every year when the cold dew solar term comes around masses of people show up at the Bachang town on the shores of the Yangcheng lake to taste the great first catch of the year.

dialogue.text: In the Bachang town many people depend on the hairy crab for a living.
dialogue.zh: 在巴城鎮，許多人靠毛蟹維生。
dialogue.ja: 巴城町では多くの人が毛蟹で生計を立てています。
dialogue.local: In the Bachang town many people depend on the hairy crab for a living.
dialogue.en: In the Bachang town many people depend on the hairy crab for a living.

dialogue.text: Ginger and his father are crab breeders and run a crab farm resort.
dialogue.zh: 姜和他的父親是蟹養殖者，經營著一個蟹農場度假村。
dialogue.ja: ジンジャーと彼の父親は蟹の養殖業者で、蟹の養殖場リゾートを経営しています。
dialogue.local: Ginger and his father are crab breeders and run a crab farm resort.
dialogue.en: Ginger and his father are crab breeders and run a crab farm resort.

dialogue.text: The boss, Mr. Jew, told me that the Yangcheng lake is mostly less than 2 meters deep which means that direct sunlight reaches all the way to the bottom.
dialogue.zh: 老闆周先生告訴我，陽澄湖大多不到2米深，這意味著陽光能直射湖底。
dialogue.ja: オーナーの周さんは、陽澄湖はほとんどが2メートル未満の深さで、直射日光が底まで届くと言いました。
dialogue.local: The boss, Mr. Jew, told me that the Yangcheng lake is mostly less than 2 meters deep which means that direct sunlight reaches all the way to the bottom.
dialogue.en: The boss, Mr. Jew, told me that the Yangcheng lake is mostly less than 2 meters deep which means that direct sunlight reaches all the way to the bottom.

dialogue.text: The lake is full of rushes and reeds among which hide many forms of aquatic life providing food for the hairy crabs.
dialogue.zh: 湖中長滿了蘆葦和芦苇，藏著許多水生生物，為毛蟹提供食物。
dialogue.ja: 湖はヨシやアシでいっぱいで、その中に多くの水生生物が隠れており、毛蟹の餌となっています。
dialogue.local: The lake is full of rushes and reeds among which hide many forms of aquatic life providing food for the hairy crabs.
dialogue.en: The lake is full of rushes and reeds among which hide many forms of aquatic life providing food for the hairy crabs.

dialogue.text: Add this to their carefully prepared crab feed and you'll see how this is just the place for crabs to grow nice and plump.
dialogue.zh: 加上他們精心準備的蟹飼料，你就會明白這裡是螃蟹長得肥美的理想之地。
dialogue.ja: これに加えて、彼らが慎重に準備した蟹の餌があり、ここが蟹がふっくらと育つ場所であることがわかります。
dialogue.local: Add this to their carefully prepared crab feed and you'll see how this is just the place for crabs to grow nice and plump.
dialogue.en: Add this to their carefully prepared crab feed and you'll see how this is just the place for crabs to grow nice and plump.

dialogue.text: If you take the Jew family, the cold dew solar term is clearly their busiest time of the year.
dialogue.zh: 對於周家來說，寒露節氣顯然是一年中最忙碌的時候。
dialogue.ja: 周家にとって、寒露の節気は明らかに一年で最も忙しい時期です。
dialogue.local: If you take the Jew family, the cold dew solar term is clearly their busiest time of the year.
dialogue.en: If you take the Jew family, the cold dew solar term is clearly their busiest time of the year.

dialogue.text: You can cook crab in so many ways but a light touch best reflects their freshness and elegant flavour, satisfying a customer's appetite is ultimately key to the success of a restaurant.
dialogue.zh: 螃蟹有很多烹調方式，但輕淡的料理最能展現其鮮美與優雅的風味，滿足顧客的胃口是餐廳成功的關鍵。
dialogue.ja: 蟹は様々な調理法がありますが、軽い味付けがその新鮮さと上品な風味を最もよく表現し、顧客の食欲を満たすことがレストランの成功の鍵です。
dialogue.local: You can cook crab in so many ways but a light touch best reflects their freshness and elegant flavour, satisfying a customer's appetite is ultimately key to the success of a restaurant.
dialogue.en: You can cook crab in so many ways but a light touch best reflects their freshness and elegant flavour, satisfying a customer's appetite is ultimately key to the success of a restaurant.

dialogue.text: Crab is a much-loved dish in China, taste is judged by how original and fresh the flavour is.
dialogue.zh: 螃蟹是中國深受喜愛的菜餚，味道的評判標準是其原汁原味和新鮮度。
dialogue.ja: 蟹は中国で非常に愛されている料理で、味はどれだけオリジナルで新鮮かによって評価されます。
dialogue.local: Crab is a much-loved dish in China, taste is judged by how original and fresh the flavour is.
dialogue.en: Crab is a much-loved dish in China, taste is judged by how original and fresh the flavour is.

dialogue.text: Whole hairy crab steamed in boiling water, creamy roe full of flavour, crab legs that are tender and sweet, this is what a hairy crab should be like and the most highly priced taste of the cold dew solar term.
dialogue.zh: 整隻毛蟹用沸水蒸熟，濃郁的蟹黃，鮮嫩甘甜的蟹腿，這就是毛蟹的標準，也是寒露節氣中最昂貴的美味。
dialogue.ja: 丸ごとの毛蟹を沸騰したお湯で蒸し、風味豊かなクリーミーな蟹卵、柔らかく甘い蟹の脚、これが毛蟹のあるべき姿であり、寒露の節気で最も高価な味です。
dialogue.local: Whole hairy crab steamed in boiling water, creamy roe full of flavour, crab legs that are tender and sweet, this is what a hairy crab should be like and the most highly priced taste of the cold dew solar term.
dialogue.en: Whole hairy crab steamed in boiling water, creamy roe full of flavour, crab legs that are tender and sweet, this is what a hairy crab should be like and the most highly priced taste of the cold dew solar term.

dialogue.text: But not every crab is perfect and for those that are too small, or might have lost a claw, what can be done?
dialogue.zh: 但不是每隻螃蟹都完美，對於太小或可能失去一隻螯的蟹，該怎麼辦？
dialogue.ja: しかし、すべての蟹が完璧というわけではなく、小さすぎたり、爪を失った蟹にはどうすればいいのでしょうか？
dialogue.local: But not every crab is perfect and for those that are too small, or might have lost a claw, what can be done?
dialogue.en: But not every crab is perfect and for those that are too small, or might have lost a claw, what can be done?

dialogue.text: Mr. Jew just cooks them up in a different way.
dialogue.zh: 周先生只是用不同的方式烹調它們。
dialogue.ja: 周さんはただ別の方法で調理します。
dialogue.local: Mr. Jew just cooks them up in a different way.
dialogue.en: Mr. Jew just cooks them up in a different way.

dialogue.text: Is that why you think it's suitable in Chinese?
dialogue.zh: 這就是你認為它適合用中文表達的原因嗎？
dialogue.ja: それが中国語で表現するのに適していると思う理由ですか？
dialogue.local: Is that why you think it's suitable in Chinese?
dialogue.en: Is that why you think it's suitable in Chinese?

dialogue.text: Yes that is.
dialogue.zh: 是的，沒錯。
dialogue.ja: はい、そうです。
dialogue.local: Yes that is.
dialogue.en: Yes that is.

dialogue.text: It's like a little bit of a drink.
dialogue.zh: 就像喝一點小酒一樣。
dialogue.ja: ちょっとした飲み物のようなものです。
dialogue.local: It's like a little bit of a drink.
dialogue.en: It's like a little bit of a drink.

dialogue.text: Crab paste is meat and roe extracted from the shell and turned into edible products.
dialogue.zh: 蟹膏是從蟹殼中提取的肉和蟹黃，製成可食用的產品。
dialogue.ja: 蟹味噌は殻から抽出された肉と卵で、食用製品に加工されます。
dialogue.local: Crab paste is meat and roe extracted from the shell and turned into edible products.
dialogue.en: Crab paste is meat and roe extracted from the shell and turned into edible products.

dialogue.text: It is one of the most important ingredients of many Chinese dishes.
dialogue.zh: 它是許多中國菜中最重要的食材之一。
dialogue.ja: それは多くの中国料理の最も重要な材料の一つです。
dialogue.local: It is one of the most important ingredients of many Chinese dishes.
dialogue.en: It is one of the most important ingredients of many Chinese dishes.

dialogue.text: For example, the well-known crab flavoured meatballs.
dialogue.zh: 例如，著名的蟹味肉丸。
dialogue.ja: 例えば、有名な蟹風味の肉団子です。
dialogue.local: For example, the well-known crab flavoured meatballs.
dialogue.en: For example, the well-known crab flavoured meatballs.

dialogue.text: The pork is minced, the crab paste is added, and the egg is mixed in evenly.
dialogue.zh: 豬肉被剁碎，加入蟹膏，並均勻混合雞蛋。
dialogue.ja: 豚肉を細かく刻み、蟹味噌を加え、卵を均等に混ぜます。
dialogue.local: The pork is minced, the crab paste is added, and the egg is mixed in evenly.
dialogue.en: The pork is minced, the crab paste is added, and the egg is mixed in evenly.

dialogue.text: This mixture turns into the large soft meatballs, known by the slightly over-the-top metaphor as lion's head.
dialogue.zh: 這混合物變成大而軟的肉丸，被戲稱為獅子頭。
dialogue.ja: この混合物は大きく柔らかい肉団子になり、やや大げさな比喩で獅子頭と呼ばれます。
dialogue.local: This mixture turns into the large soft meatballs, known by the slightly over-the-top metaphor as lion's head.
dialogue.en: This mixture turns into the large soft meatballs, known by the slightly over-the-top metaphor as lion's head.

dialogue.text: They're super tasty, but try cramming one of these into your mouth hole.
dialogue.zh: 它們非常美味，但試著把一個整個塞進嘴裡。
dialogue.ja: とても美味しいですが、これを一つ丸ごと口に入れてみてください。
dialogue.local: They're super tasty, but try cramming one of these into your mouth hole.
dialogue.en: They're super tasty, but try cramming one of these into your mouth hole.

dialogue.text: Actually, I'm not a major fan of crab.
dialogue.zh: 其實，我不是很喜歡吃螃蟹。
dialogue.ja: 実は、私は蟹の大ファンではありません。
dialogue.local: Actually, I'm not a major fan of crab.
dialogue.en: Actually, I'm not a major fan of crab.

dialogue.text: It's hard to eat, and you get the thinnest amount of meat from it.
dialogue.zh: 螃蟹不好吃，而且肉很少。
dialogue.ja: 食べにくく、肉もわずかしか取れません。
dialogue.local: It's hard to eat, and you get the thinnest amount of meat from it.
dialogue.en: It's hard to eat, and you get the thinnest amount of meat from it.

dialogue.text: But the Chinese have had a ridiculously long history of indulging on crab, and they've invented ways to make the process clean, tidy, and skillful.
dialogue.zh: 但中國人對吃螃蟹有著極長的歷史，並發明了讓過程乾淨、整潔且巧妙的方法。
dialogue.ja: しかし、中国人は蟹を楽しむ非常に長い歴史があり、その過程を清潔で整然とし、巧みにする方法を発明しました。
dialogue.local: But the Chinese have had a ridiculously long history of indulging on crab, and they've invented ways to make the process clean, tidy, and skillful.
dialogue.en: But the Chinese have had a ridiculously long history of indulging on crab, and they've invented ways to make the process clean, tidy, and skillful.

dialogue.text: This is the taste of the plate.
dialogue.zh: 這就是盤中的味道。
dialogue.ja: これが皿の味です。
dialogue.local: This is the taste of the plate.
dialogue.en: This is the taste of the plate.

dialogue.text: It's just so good this week.
dialogue.zh: 這週的味道真是太棒了。
dialogue.ja: 今週は本当に美味しいです。
dialogue.local: It's just so good this week.
dialogue.en: It's just so good this week.

dialogue.text: Is the word Hello, Mooji family?
dialogue.zh: 這句話是“你好，穆吉家族”嗎？
dialogue.ja: 「こんにちは、ムージー家族」という言葉ですか？
dialogue.local: Is the word Hello, Mooji family?
dialogue.en: Is the word Hello, Mooji family?

dialogue.text: Mooji Some eggs.
dialogue.zh: 穆吉一些蛋。
dialogue.ja: ムージーの卵です。
dialogue.local: Mooji Some eggs.
dialogue.en: Mooji Some eggs.

dialogue.text: Peace out.
dialogue.zh: 再見。
dialogue.ja: さようなら。
dialogue.local: Peace out.
dialogue.en: Peace out.

dialogue.text: Come on.
dialogue.zh: 來吧。
dialogue.ja: さあ。
dialogue.local: Come on.
dialogue.en: Come on.

dialogue.text: Leg is too good.
dialogue.zh: 蟹腿太美味了。
dialogue.ja: 脚がとても美味しいです。
dialogue.local: Leg is too good.
dialogue.en: Leg is too good.

dialogue.text: Listening to the Kunqu songs while eating crab is one of the most refined customs of the Cold Dew solar term, passed on to us by the ancient Chinese.
dialogue.zh: 在寒露節氣吃蟹時聽昆曲，是古代中國人傳承下來的最優雅的習俗之一。
dialogue.ja: 寒露の節気に蟹を食べながら昆曲を聴くことは、古代中国人から伝わる最も洗練された習慣の一つです。
dialogue.local: Listening to the Kunqu songs while eating crab is one of the most refined customs of the Cold Dew solar term, passed on to us by the ancient Chinese.
dialogue.en: Listening to the Kunqu songs while eating crab is one of the most refined customs of the Cold Dew solar term, passed on to us by the ancient Chinese.

dialogue.text: I tend to think of it as if in my hometown in the UK people would have afternoon tea and talk about Shakespeare.
dialogue.zh: 我傾向於把它想像成在我英國的家鄉，人們會喝下午茶並談論莎士比亞。
dialogue.ja: 私はこれを、私の故郷イギリスで人々がアフタヌーンティーをしながらシェイクスピアについて話すようなものだと思っています。
dialogue.local: I tend to think of it as if in my hometown in the UK people would have afternoon tea and talk about Shakespeare.
dialogue.en: I tend to think of it as if in my hometown in the UK people would have afternoon tea and talk about Shakespeare.

dialogue.text: It's such a refined high culture sort of pastime but it seems the Chinese are even more particular, adding to the elegant custom a fairly unchangeable natural event, the shift from autumn to winter.
dialogue.zh: 這是一種非常高雅的文化娛樂，但中國人似乎更講究，將這優雅的習俗與一個幾乎不變的自然事件——秋冬交替結合起來。
dialogue.ja: それは非常に洗練された高文化的な娯楽ですが、中国人はさらにこだわり、優雅な習慣にほとんど変わらない自然現象、秋から冬への移り変わりを加えています。
dialogue.local: It's such a refined high culture sort of pastime but it seems the Chinese are even more particular, adding to the elegant custom a fairly unchangeable natural event, the shift from autumn to winter.
dialogue.en: It's such a refined high culture sort of pastime but it seems the Chinese are even more particular, adding to the elegant custom a fairly unchangeable natural event, the shift from autumn to winter.

dialogue.text: Gou Ying is a professional Kunqu master and she's quite famous in China.
dialogue.zh: 苟英是專業的昆曲大師，在中國相當有名。
dialogue.ja: 苟英はプロの昆曲の名手で、中国でかなり有名です。
dialogue.local: Gou Ying is a professional Kunqu master and she's quite famous in China.
dialogue.en: Gou Ying is a professional Kunqu master and she's quite famous in China.

dialogue.text: Although she's been residing in Beijing for a long time now she actually comes from Bachang town and for the Cold Dew solar term every year she comes back to her hometown to perform.
dialogue.zh: 雖然她已在北京居住很久，但她其實來自巴城鎮，每年寒露節氣都會回家鄉表演。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は長い間北京に住んでいますが、実は巴城町出身で、寒露の節気には毎年故郷に戻って公演します。
dialogue.local: Although she's been residing in Beijing for a long time now she actually comes from Bachang town and for the Cold Dew solar term every year she comes back to her hometown to perform.
dialogue.en: Although she's been residing in Beijing for a long time now she actually comes from Bachang town and for the Cold Dew solar term every year she comes back to her hometown to perform.

dialogue.text: As the oldest surviving form of opera in China Kunqu is known as the ancestor of all opera of China as well as the world famous Peking opera that all came from Kunqu.
dialogue.zh: 昆曲是中國現存最古老的戲曲形式，被稱為中國所有戲曲的祖先，也包括世界著名的京劇，皆源自昆曲。
dialogue.ja: 昆曲は中国で最も古く現存するオペラの形態であり、中国のすべてのオペラの祖先として知られ、世界的に有名な京劇も昆曲から派生しました。
dialogue.local: As the oldest surviving form of opera in China Kunqu is known as the ancestor of all opera of China as well as the world famous Peking opera that all came from Kunqu.
dialogue.en: As the oldest surviving form of opera in China Kunqu is known as the ancestor of all opera of China as well as the world famous Peking opera that all came from Kunqu.

dialogue.text: Intense preparations are underway for the show.
dialogue.zh: 演出正緊鑼密鼓地準備中。
dialogue.ja: 公演の準備が着々と進んでいます。
dialogue.local: Intense preparations are underway for the show.
dialogue.en: Intense preparations are underway for the show.

dialogue.text: Gou Ying has a leading role.
dialogue.zh: 苟英擔任主角。
dialogue.ja: 苟英が主役を務めます。
dialogue.local: Gou Ying has a leading role.
dialogue.en: Gou Ying has a leading role.

dialogue.text: The venue of this year's performance is Yu-Shan-Shan-Jin in the Bachang town.
dialogue.zh: 今年的演出場地是巴城鎮的御山山金。
dialogue.ja: 今年の公演会場は巴城町の御山山金です。
dialogue.local: The venue of this year's performance is Yu-Shan-Shan-Jin in the Bachang town.
dialogue.en: The venue of this year's performance is Yu-Shan-Shan-Jin in the Bachang town.

dialogue.text: Legend has it that this was one of Bachang town's most coveted private gardens.
dialogue.zh: 傳說這是巴城鎮最受珍視的私人花園之一。
dialogue.ja: 伝説によると、ここは巴城町で最も憧れられた私庭の一つでした。
dialogue.local: Legend has it that this was one of Bachang town's most coveted private gardens.
dialogue.en: Legend has it that this was one of Bachang town's most coveted private gardens.

dialogue.text: This is a typical Suzhou style garden building surrounded by landscaped nature.
dialogue.zh: 這是一座典型的蘇州風格園林建築，四周環繞著景觀自然。
dialogue.ja: これは典型的な蘇州風の庭園建築で、自然の景観に囲まれています。
dialogue.local: This is a typical Suzhou style garden building surrounded by landscaped nature.
dialogue.en: This is a typical Suzhou style garden building surrounded by landscaped nature.

dialogue.text: Made to look like a Chinese landscaped painting and idyllic nature scape within the bustling city.
dialogue.zh: 被打造得像一幅中國山水畫，是繁忙城市中的田園風光。
dialogue.ja: 賑やかな都市の中にある中国の風景画のような牧歌的な自然景観に作られています。
dialogue.local: Made to look like a Chinese landscaped painting and idyllic nature scape within the bustling city.
dialogue.en: Made to look like a Chinese landscaped painting and idyllic nature scape within the bustling city.

dialogue.text: A thousand years ago Chinese intellectuals would pass the day in such a place, spending the Cold Dew solar term with family and friends.
dialogue.zh: 一千年前，中國知識分子會在這樣的地方度過一天，與家人朋友共度寒露節氣。
dialogue.ja: 1000年前、中国の知識人はこのような場所で一日を過ごし、寒露の節気を家族や友人と共に過ごしました。
dialogue.local: A thousand years ago Chinese intellectuals would pass the day in such a place, spending the Cold Dew solar term with family and friends.
dialogue.en: A thousand years ago Chinese intellectuals would pass the day in such a place, spending the Cold Dew solar term with family and friends.

dialogue.text: The singing will begin very soon, pre-show preparations are very complicated.
dialogue.zh: 演唱即將開始，演出前的準備非常複雜。
dialogue.ja: 歌唱はまもなく始まります。公演前の準備は非常に複雑です。
dialogue.local: The singing will begin very soon, pre-show preparations are very complicated.
dialogue.en: The singing will begin very soon, pre-show preparations are very complicated.

dialogue.text: It takes nearly two hours to get ready, but finally Gou Ying is about to come on stage.
dialogue.zh: 準備近兩小時，但苟英終於要上台了。
dialogue.ja: 準備にはほぼ2時間かかりますが、ついに苟英が舞台に上がろうとしています。
dialogue.local: It takes nearly two hours to get ready, but finally Gou Ying is about to come on stage.
dialogue.en: It takes nearly two hours to get ready, but finally Gou Ying is about to come on stage.

dialogue.text: The song is about to be a whole trans-yolite.
dialogue.zh: 歌曲即將開始。
dialogue.ja: 歌がまもなく始まります。
dialogue.local: The song is about to be a whole trans-yolite.
dialogue.en: The song is about to be a whole trans-yolite.

dialogue.text: Misku will play Ming Dynasty's dramatist Tang Xianzu's Only Pavilion, a very beautiful love story, and it reminds me once again of Shakespeare's tragedies.
dialogue.zh: 米斯庫將演出明代劇作家湯顯祖的《牡丹亭》，一個非常美麗的愛情故事，讓我再次想起莎士比亞的悲劇。
dialogue.ja: ミスクは明代の劇作家、湯顕祖の『牡丹亭』を演じます。とても美しい恋物語で、再びシェイクスピアの悲劇を思い出させます。
dialogue.local: Misku will play Ming Dynasty's dramatist Tang Xianzu's Only Pavilion, a very beautiful love story, and it reminds me once again of Shakespeare's tragedies.
dialogue.en: Misku will play Ming Dynasty's dramatist Tang Xianzu's Only Pavilion, a very beautiful love story, and it reminds me once again of Shakespeare's tragedies.

dialogue.text: Written far far away, but in roughly the same literary period, the two dramatists even died in the same year.
dialogue.zh: 兩位劇作家雖然相隔遙遠，但大致處於同一文學時期，甚至同年去世。
dialogue.ja: 遠く離れて書かれましたが、ほぼ同じ文学時代で、二人の劇作家は同じ年に亡くなりました。
dialogue.local: Written far far away, but in roughly the same literary period, the two dramatists even died in the same year.
dialogue.en: Written far far away, but in roughly the same literary period, the two dramatists even died in the same year.

dialogue.text: I have to say Kunqu is even harder to understand than Shakespeare's plays.
dialogue.zh: 我必須說昆曲比莎士比亞的戲劇更難理解。
dialogue.ja: 昆曲はシェイクスピアの劇よりも理解が難しいと言わざるを得ません。
dialogue.local: I have to say Kunqu is even harder to understand than Shakespeare's plays.
dialogue.en: I have to say Kunqu is even harder to understand than Shakespeare's plays.

dialogue.text: The texts are written as people spoke a thousand years ago.
dialogue.zh: 文本是用一千年前人們的語言寫成的。
dialogue.ja: テキストは1000年前の人々が話していた言葉で書かれています。
dialogue.local: The texts are written as people spoke a thousand years ago.
dialogue.en: The texts are written as people spoke a thousand years ago.

dialogue.text: The rhythm and melody is extremely slow.
dialogue.zh: 節奏和旋律非常緩慢。
dialogue.ja: リズムとメロディーは非常にゆっくりです。
dialogue.local: The rhythm and melody is extremely slow.
dialogue.en: The rhythm and melody is extremely slow.

dialogue.text: It's hard to understand how, in today's fast-paced society, it attracts such a big audience.
dialogue.zh: 很難理解在當今快節奏的社會中，它如何吸引如此龐大的觀眾。
dialogue.ja: 今日の速い社会で、どうしてこれほど多くの観客を引きつけるのか理解しにくいです。
dialogue.local: It's hard to understand how, in today's fast-paced society, it attracts such a big audience.
dialogue.en: It's hard to understand how, in today's fast-paced society, it attracts such a big audience.

dialogue.text: Maybe when society develops to a certain stage, some people will want to go back to their roots to discover who they are and where they come from.
dialogue.zh: 也許當社會發展到一定階段，有些人會想回歸根源，尋找自我和來處。
dialogue.ja: 社会がある段階に達すると、人々は自分が誰でどこから来たのかを知るためにルーツに戻りたくなるかもしれません。
dialogue.local: Maybe when society develops to a certain stage, some people will want to go back to their roots to discover who they are and where they come from.
dialogue.en: Maybe when society develops to a certain stage, some people will want to go back to their roots to discover who they are and where they come from.

dialogue.text: Cold Dew may not be the most beautiful solar term in terms of nature, but it may well be one that is tied most closely to an overload of sensory experiences.
dialogue.zh: 寒露在自然景觀上可能不是最美的節氣，但它可能是與感官體驗最密切相關的節氣。
dialogue.ja: 寒露は自然の美しさでは最も美しい節気ではないかもしれませんが、感覚的な体験と最も密接に結びついている節気かもしれません。
dialogue.local: Cold Dew may not be the most beautiful solar term in terms of nature, but it may well be one that is tied most closely to an overload of sensory experiences.
dialogue.en: Cold Dew may not be the most beautiful solar term in terms of nature, but it may well be one that is tied most closely to an overload of sensory experiences.

dialogue.text: And I was surprised to discover connections between China and the United Kingdom in terms of traditional culture.
dialogue.zh: 我驚訝地發現中國和英國在傳統文化方面的聯繫。
dialogue.ja: 伝統文化に関して中国とイギリスのつながりを発見して驚きました。
dialogue.local: And I was surprised to discover connections between China and the United Kingdom in terms of traditional culture.
dialogue.en: And I was surprised to discover connections between China and the United Kingdom in terms of traditional culture.

dialogue.text: Whether derived by accident or coincidence, I think traditional culture is a common good, transcending the boundaries between nations and eras, able to live us all.
dialogue.zh: 無論是偶然還是巧合，我認為傳統文化是共同的財富，超越國家和時代的界限，能夠連結我們所有人。
dialogue.ja: 偶然か必然かは別として、伝統文化は共通の財産であり、国や時代の境界を超えて私たちすべてをつなぐものだと思います。
dialogue.local: Whether derived by accident or coincidence, I think traditional culture is a common good, transcending the boundaries between nations and eras, able to live us all.
dialogue.en: Whether derived by accident or coincidence, I think traditional culture is a common good, transcending the boundaries between nations and eras, able to live us all.
